verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships MCP servers (Airbyte Agents) that let AI agents like Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and Codex query, search, and act on connected data via natural-language prompts through those clients, plus an AI Assistant that auto-configures Connector Builder fields from natural-language-like input. However, there is no evidence of a native natural-language interface within Airbyte's own UI/product for operating syncs, connections, or configuration directly. missing for 10: first-party natural-language command interface within Airbyte itself (not just via third-party MCP clients), independent hands-on evidence of NL-driven operation, and NL support for broader operations beyond connector building/agent data access.
